annotation.title_clean: Annexes to the Proposal for a Regulation Laying Down Harmonised Rules on Artificial Intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) and Amending Certain Union Legislative Acts
annotation.title_en: Annexes to the Proposal for a Regulation Laying Down Harmonised Rules on Artificial Intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) and Amending Certain Union Legislative Acts
annotation.summary_en: Annexes 1–9 to the European Commission's April 2021 proposal for the EU AI Act. They define AI techniques, list Union harmonisation legislation (machinery, medical devices, vehicles, aviation/unmanned aircraft), enumerate high-risk AI use areas, and set out technical documentation and conformity assessment procedures.
key_provisions_or_claims: Annex I defines AI techniques: machine learning, logic/knowledge-based, and statistical approaches.
Annex II lists Union harmonisation legislation (machinery, toys, medical devices, vehicles, unmanned aircraft) triggering high-risk status for safety components.
Annex III lists high-risk areas: biometrics, critical infrastructure, education, employment, essential services, law enforcement, migration, justice.
Annex IV specifies mandatory technical documentation content.
Annexes VI–VII set conformity assessment via internal control or quality management system and technical documentation assessment.
